hotel_name: Hotel O By Oyo Kashish Residency

negative_snippets:
I had a very bad experience at Kashish Regency, Malta Ganj. The room and bed had a terrible smell, there were insects in the room, and even rats were inside the room at night, which was extremely disturbing. The blanket was very dirty with a bad odor, and they didn't provide a fresh towel.

Even after making an online payment through OYO, the hotel staff charged me an extra ₹1000, which is completely unacceptable.

I will not suggest this hotel to anyone, and no one should stay here. Totally disappointing and not worth the money
